description_en: Queries the check list of extension events
description_zh: 查询扩展事件的检查列表
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-check-processes --project-id 123465 --event-code commit-file --operator 123333 --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --status True --message-id 03400b03-b721-4c34-8727-200001 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCheckProcesses

parameters.help_en: The event code of the extension point
parameters.name: event_code

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. This parameter is used for paging
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询，每页显示的条数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number in a paged query. This parameter is used for paging. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时的页码，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The check status of the extension. Valid values:

CHECKING: The check is in progress.
PASSED: The check is passed.
BLOCKED: The check is not passed
parameters.help_zh:
扩展程序检查状态。
CHECKING 检查中
PASSED 检查通过
BLOCKED 检查不通过
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The message ID of the DataWorks open message. After an extension point event is triggered, you can obtain the message ID from the received event message.

<props="china">For the message format, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/215367.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks开放消息的消息ID。当触发扩展点事件后，您可以从接收到的事件消息中获取消息ID。

<props="china">消息格式，可参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/215367.html。</props>
parameters.name: message_id
